page.layout: One page of text, one column, centred; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword-like signature "Q 6" centred below the last line, followed by "pli-" at right; a faint fragment of a neighbouring page at the left edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: de luto dices, de quifquiliis, de calceis & caligis: & de quovis horum diffusè dices ac tomis integris: Ars id tua promittit, promittunt illi Typi, quos confuetus afpectas, velut totidem femitas in ampliffimos dicendi campos excurrentes; Sed fi de calceis(ut hos duntaxat in Exemplum affumamus ) more tuo fcripferis, per Etymologiam, Conjugationem, Homonymiam, Synonymiam, Caufas, Effecta, Species & reliquos Typos difcurrendo (ut liberrimos hîc difcurfus offerunt ifti Typi) non unum tamen futorem formet commentatio tua: ipfe etiam à lucubratione ista nihil inftructior, calceum non conficias, imo ne refarcias quidem, qua parte detritus eft aut rimam agit. Vides igitur omiffâ totâ aliquâ Difcipli-nâ, de Objecto tamen iftius Difci-pli-

page.notes: The word "pli-" at the lower right is the catchword, set after the signature "Q 6"; the bleed-through text at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is omitted. The text is in the Latin of the original; the last line ends a hyphenated word, so the catchword "pli-" is given within the paragraph as printed.
